description: This file is a Perl module script for handling GET requests within the Coocook project. It defines a class with attributes for command-line arguments and a path, and includes methods to initialize with options and execute a GET request, printing the response body.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Get
classes.description: A Perl class for executing a GET request and printing the response body, with command-line argument parsing and URL handling.

methods.name: new_with_options
methods.description: Initializes the object with command-line options, validating that exactly one URI path argument is provided.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs the GET request to the specified URI and prints the response body.
